name: cicada-guide
description: Research U.S. state bills, legislative text, recorded votes, and legislator contacts.

interface.longDescription: Research U.S. state legislation with sourced bill briefs, recorded voting histories, and legislator contact details. Explore bill results, bill workspaces, voting records, and contact cards. Read-only public records. Coverage and freshness depend on the available records. Does not cover Congress or identify representatives by address, rank legislators, predict votes, or contact officials.

positive.description: Search state bills. Setup: fresh chat with Cicada Guide enabled; public live records, no credentials.
positive.prompt: Find Alabama HB591 from the 2026 Regular Session.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Alabama and the 2026 Regular Session to returned UUIDs, search bill HB591 within them, report only matching candidates and show the results card.

positive.description: Read bill and show workspace. Setup: fresh chat with Cicada Guide enabled; public live records, no credentials.
positive.prompt: Brief me on Alabama HB591 from the 2026 Regular Session, including text, sponsors, and floor votes.
positive.tools_triggered: list_states, list_sessions, search_bills, get_bill_dossier, get_latest_bill_document, show_bill
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the exact bill and read every text chunk before summarizing, or disclose unavailable text. Accept dossier roll calls when rollcalls.has_more is false, count and total equal items.length, and no warning indicates failed or incomplete floor-vote retrieval. Otherwise continue get_rollcalls with the same bill_id and returned next_offset; start at offset 0 if completeness metadata is missing/inconsistent or retrieval failed. Follow pagination and retain warnings; disclose any unresolved incomplete coverage even when has_more is false. Preserve each tally and dated status. Show the bill with id, headline and summary grounded in returned evidence. A complete dossier does not require a duplicate get_rollcalls call. Deliver the brief and any limitations in the bill workspace. Assistant commentary and the final assistant message are empty.

positive.description: Recorded voting history. Setup: fresh chat with Cicada Guide enabled; public live records, no credentials.
positive.prompt: How did Alabama Representative Rex Reynolds vote most recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Verify identity and Alabama seat or vote context, then report latest recorded date, measure, position and tally with coverage limits; display person record. Do not invent within-day order.

positive.description: Recorded contact details. Setup: fresh chat with Cicada Guide enabled; public live records, no credentials.
positive.prompt: How can I contact Alabama Representative Rex Reynolds?
positive.expected_behavior: Verify identity and state; report only recorded contact and seat values, disclose missing fields, show official card, and send no message.

positive.description: Conversation default override. Setup: fresh chat with Cicada Guide enabled; public live records, no credentials.
positive.prompt: For this task my default state is Alabama. Now find Texas HB1 in the 2025 Regular Session.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Texas and its requested session, search HB1 only in Texas despite the Alabama default. Ask about ambiguity rather than guessing.
